Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team found Redwood's performance promising. We'd like to schedule a technical deep-dive focused on private deployment options (VPC peering, on-prem packaging, and air-gapped requirements). Our security and infra leads will join.

Goal: get a clear checklist of network requirements, encryption at rest/in-transit, and any on-prem install constraints.

Would you have 60-90 minutes next week? Our preferred windows are:
- Tue 5/5 10:00-11:30 PT
- Wed 5/6 13:00-14:30 PT
- Thu 5/7 09:00-10:30 PT

I'll loop in Anna Li (cloud security) once we lock a slot.

Thanks,
Sam Trask
IT Infrastructure Manager
Aegis Health
